column1: # Closed facts about the zclassicd tree. One row per line:
# `zcl-dev know <term>` answers from these rows; `zcl-dev know --check` validates them.
#!relations selects needs decided-by trap-of documents guards checked-by implements
#!contexts ci consensus wallet qa build network tooling node storage rpc
#!terms src/main.cpp ALL wallet_matrix leased-ports consensus zclassicd

column6: zcutil/dev/impact.rules maps src/main.cpp to every local-ci test step, so a change there never skips consensus or wallet tests
qa scripts take an explicit leased port base and fail fast on a bound port
zclassicd is the reference; Z23 matches it bug for bug and a divergence is fixed to match
ports derived from the PID collided under parallel runs several times in one release cycle
SetBestChain under cs_main alone deadlocked a notifier-thread write; the order is cs_main, cs_wallet, mempool.cs
the environment opens with DB_TXN_WRITE_NOSYNC, so a commit is not durable until an explicit flush
the table reproduces historical chain behaviour and is never tidied
read it before touching the table or the Groth16 point-decode quirk
release builds use GCC 9, so linkable C compiles as gnu17 with zero warnings
fails on a changed blob or an unlisted file under a vendor directory
an unprefixed global in libzcl_c23.a collides with libsodium or OpenSSL at link time
-testcrashpoint and the other -test hooks are accepted on regtest only, so no production node can be told to exit
the CI rootfs runs with --clearenv so host-only variables cannot leak into a step
sanitizer steps run under setarch -R because high mmap entropy makes the sanitizer runtime loop
the dispatcher; each other zcl-dev subcommand is its own zcl-dev-<cmd> binary
check-docs fails when a lesson line has another shape or names an untracked path
know --check enforces the closed vocabulary, tracked paths, no duplicates and no unused terms
snapshot serving needs process-wide caps as well as per-IP quotas; the caps are opt-in
without the Windows job object a killed wallet leaves the embedded daemon running on its datadir
a node killed before its first chainstate flush restarts from height 0 and the test waits for the re-sync
MinGW C code needs -D__USE_MINGW_ANSI_STDIO=1 for %zu, set for libzcl_c23.a

a proving-parameter re-hash is skipped only when the file size equals the compiled size, the cached size and mtime match, the cached hash equals the compiled hash, the cache epoch matches and the cache file is owner-only; the cache never supplies a hash to trust
the verified-params cache is <datadir>/params-verify.cache (0600); -noparamcache hashes every file, -paramcache is on by default
sprout-verifying.key never takes the cache skip because its SHA-256 is the only pre-load integrity gate of a consensus-relevant param; the other four files may skip

a torn write that keeps both size and mtime is skipped and the corrupt param loads; the code records this as a bounded non-consensus residual that fails at use and self-heals through the bootstrap re-fetch
CompiledParamEpoch hashes name, sha256 and size of every compiled param spec, so a binary with a different table invalidates the whole cache (downgrade and multi-version safe)
a clean Shutdown() writes <datadir>/shutdown.clean last, binding the chain tip, the coins best block and a digest of block-file and LevelDB file names, sizes and mtimes
ConsumeCleanMarker removes the marker whether or not it parsed, so a crash or kill after one start leaves no marker for the next
the files digest covers names, sizes and mtimes, not content, so in-place bit rot that keeps size and mtime is not seen by the shortened check

after a matched marker the start-up VerifyDB checks the last 6 blocks at level 3, otherwise the full default depth; qa/rpc-tests/chain_clean_shutdown_marker.sh shows the full check after kill -9, a touched chainstate/CURRENT or a changed blk00000.dat
-cleanshutdownmarker is on by default and ignored whenever -checkblocks or -checklevel is given, on reindex and on a bootstrap import

MaybeWriteCleanShutdownMarker writes only after the chain load was verified, with no reindex or import, no raised warning, the coins best block at the tip and no bootstrap validation or install pending
strMiscWarning also carries non-fatal warnings (clock skew, unknown versions), so a run with one writes no marker; safe but less precise, found in the wave-1 review of the start-up unit

PreverifyHeadersEquihash verifies Equihash solutions of a headers message on up to 8 threads outside cs_main and only warms the positive Equihash memo; the serial AcceptBlockHeader loop still checks every header
the pre-pass does nothing below 8 candidate headers, on a single-core host, with -noheaderprecheck or with the memo disabled, and stops claiming headers after the first failure

candidate selection skips leading headers known to mapBlockIndex even when marked failed, so a peer can have up to 160 valid-Equihash headers verified that the serial loop would stop at; cost is bounded and consensus is unchanged (wave-1 review)
the headers handler calls PreverifyHeadersEquihash before it takes cs_main and the serial loop afterwards re-checks each header

the Equihash memo stores only valid block hashes, a miss runs the full verifier and eviction only turns a hit into a miss; the table is 4-way set-associative with a per-process salt and holds 32768 hashes by default
the Sapling verdict cache is keyed by txid and consensus branch id and records successes only, so an invalid transaction cannot be accepted because of it
-maxshieldedcachesize sets the verdict cache in MiB at 64 bytes per entry, default 4, and 0 disables it
ContextualCheckTransaction consults ShieldedVerdictContains before the Sapling proof and signature block and inserts only after it succeeded, so the second evaluation at block connection can skip it
the ECDSA signature cache defaults to 40 MiB, bounded to limit DoS exposure
LevelDB max_open_files per database is (RLIMIT_NOFILE soft limit minus 150 core fds, nMaxConnections and 128) divided by 2, clamped to 64..1000; Windows uses a fixed 512
-dbmaxopenfiles overrides the derived budget and is clamped to 64..4096 but is not checked against the real fd limit

the budget splits the fd allowance between the block index and the chainstate, but -zslpindex opens a third CDBWrapper and the payment-disclosure store opens a raw LevelDB with the default 1000; harmless on 64-bit where tables are mmapped, over budget on a 32-bit build (wave-1 review)
dbwrapper_max_open_files_budget asserts only that the budget lies in 64..1000, so an arithmetic regression inside that range is not caught
RpcCallBegin and RpcCallEnd keep a table of 128 in-flight calls and per-method aggregates for at most 512 method names, then count under (other)
only method names and durations are recorded; parameters are never stored or logged
the stats code takes no cs_main and holds its two private mutexes never together with another lock
getrpcinfo returns active_commands (method and duration_us) and methods (count, total_us, max_us, errors)
-rpcslowlog=<ms> logs a WARN line with the method name for calls taking at least that long; default 1000, 0 disables
RpcCallEnd with id 0 or an unknown id counts the call under (other) with zero microseconds because it has no method name; RpcCallScope keeps the name through RpcCallAccount (wave-1 review)
getconnectioncount and getpeerinfo take only cs_vNodes, not cs_main; the implementer measured 15909 ms before and 4 ms after while verifychain held cs_main (wave-1 review)
the script drives getrpcinfo and the slow-call WARN on a two-node regtest; its WARN check prints SKIP instead of failing when no call reaches 1 ms
a full RPC work queue answers HTTP 503 with a JSON-RPC body naming -rpcworkqueue and -rpcthreads and logs one rate-limited line
defaults are 4 RPC threads, a work queue of 16 and a 30 s server timeout
ValidateRpcTuning refuses -rpcthreads outside 1..256, -rpcworkqueue outside 1..65536 and -rpcservertimeout outside 1..86400 at start-up instead of clamping
a tuning failure is logged by LogPrintf, shown by ThreadSafeMessageBox and then reported again by the caller as a generic HTTP start failure (wave-1 review)
the script fills the work queue with bursts of 20 requests (up to 5 retries), expects the 503 body and the log line, and checks that out-of-range -rpcthreads stops start-up
the onion service private key is written through zcl_keyfile_write: owner-only, a temporary file renamed into place, never partial
the control connection authenticates with Tor SAFECOOKIE (HMAC-SHA256 server and client hashes over the cookie and both nonces) and creates the P2P onion service with ADD_ONION
-embeddedtormode defaults to child on Linux and to inprocess elsewhere; child keeps a Tor bug out of the process that holds the wallet
-embeddedtor with no Tor in the build, a bad mode or -onion=0 stops start-up, and a Tor that exits later shuts the node down instead of continuing in the clear
-listenonion defaults on and -listen=0 switches it off through parameter interaction
records the Tor commit f4e28103c0eb9016e0b500d02486b7a59d20ee5d, the source archive sha256 and the zlib 1.3.1 pin that depends builds

without the carried patches the Tor fork activates a second ephemeral onion service every second once it has a circuit and serves demo pages on port 80; doc/tor-provenance.md records the pre-patch observation
atomic write, tighten and read of owner-only secret files; always built into zclassicd through libzcl_tor.a even without embedded Tor
the tor-twonode, tor-threenode and tor-addrv2gossip CI steps run only with --tor because they need real Tor network access
a strace check that only the Tor process reaches the network when a node runs behind embedded Tor
every connected block is one atomic LevelDB batch with its undo record and the new best block, so a crash leaves the store at a block boundary and a disconnect restores the prior state
the name index applies each block with the same undo-record batch discipline as the token index
-zslpindex and -znamindex need the full block files and refuse to start together with -prune
zslp and znam RPC commands answer a disabled error naming -zslpindex=1 or -znamindex=1 unless the index runs
the mainnet index starts at height 650000, the first block with a ZSLP transaction, taken from real mainnet token fixtures
the name index reads block undo data to learn the owner of each spent input and fails with a named error when the undo data is not readable
wallet spends classify dust outputs that carry token quantities or a baton and keep them out of ordinary coin selection
src/test/data/token_name_rules.txt is a copy shared with Z23 and checked by this script; never edit it locally
NODE_BOOTSTRAP is service bit 1 << 24 and marks peers that serve bootstrap snapshots
getbsman and getbschk framing, 1 MiB chunks, 16 chunk requests in flight, 60 s message timeout and the server limits
-bootstrapstreams opens 4 parallel snapshot connections by default and at most 16
pure decision logic for resuming an interrupted snapshot download that trusts no staged file and decides only from measured sizes and SHA-256 values
trustless mode re-derives the UTXO set from genesis into a scratch chainstate and compares hash_serialized; a match latches validated, a mismatch discards and reindexes
ConnectBlock takes fScratchView so the background replay suppresses txindex writes, block index mutation, undo writes and wallet signals
a partial snapshot kept for resume is removed at start-up under -bootstrap=0 and kept when bootstrap is on; a killed download once left up to about 11 GB of staging in the datadir
-bootstrap=0 disables snapshot fast sync and syncs and validates from genesis, which trusts no peer
a build with DEBUG_LOCKORDER reports lock-order violations; the local-ci debug flavor enables it
FileCommit flushes and then calls fdatasync on Linux, F_FULLFSYNC on macOS and FlushFileBuffers on Windows
DirectoryCommit fsyncs the directory so a rename into it is durable and does nothing on Windows
the block index is written hourly (every 5 minutes in IBD), the full chain state at least daily and, at the tip, every 10 minutes by default (-dbflushinterval)
before the periodic tip flush a kill -9 after 40 to 80 minutes restarted at the start-up height and refetched every block since
TestCrashPoint is inert unless -testcrashpoint is given and then _exit(77) at the named point
what is written to wallet.dat and when, what start-up reconciliation checks, the crash points and the lost-witness flag
ReconcileNoteState cuts or drops only cached witness data and re-derives a missing Sapling nullifier; no transaction or key is dropped to repair state
once shutdown is requested and fNoteWitnessesLost is set, SetBestChain writes nothing so a stop never waits on a rescan from genesis; the next start repairs it (commit 9f683fe1b)
kills the wallet at random points and at named crash points, restarts without -rescan and compares balances and unspent outputs with a rescanned reference; 12 seeds by default
variant 6 builds the on-disk state of a shutdown with a pending witness rebuild and compares the repair with a -rescan reference
block files within MIN_BLOCKS_TO_KEEP (288) of the tip are never pruned
an invalidated block stays failed across restarts and pruning and reconsiderblock must still leave the node consistent after its block file is pruned
inserts a stale record header before each of many records and requires the reindex to reach the same height and best hash with contiguous records afterwards
SelectOutboundCandidate draws at most 300 times per round and does not redial an address within 60 s; a same-group or local draw does not use up the round
ReserveDialGroup lets only one outbound dial per network group be in flight
fixed seeds are added once while the address table holds fewer than 16 addresses; they used to wait for a full minute of empty table that a fresh node never had (commit 535dad6d7)
a protocol message is at most 2 MiB, an inv at most 50000 entries and addr replies at most 1000 entries
a headers message carries at most 160 headers (MAX_HEADERS_RESULTS)
pins size caps and ban scores of the P2P handlers by feeding whole wire messages to a CNode; the suite took 51.7 s under host load against a 12 s unloaded run
fixed-seed mutations of valid serializations may end only in success or std::ios_base::failure; a failure prints the PRNG seed, seed object and case number
the libFuzzer harnesses build only on request and the build script is Linux only because it links with --start-group
CInv::ToString throws std::out_of_range for unknown inv types; the first libFuzzer crash showed it and ProcessMessages catches it, but the handler logs inv.ToString only under -debug=net
iso_base leases a block of free ports from zcl-port, one O_EXCL file per port, default range 12000-17900, and rebases between scenarios
a detached reaper kills every process tagged with ZCL_ISO_TAG after the script ends by any means including kill -9 and releases the port leases
port leases are created with O_EXCL, record the owner pid and reclaim stale owners
flags literal /tmp/, default datadirs without -datadir and fixed -port or -rpcport in qa scripts
every step has a wall-clock timeout and a log size cap (default 256 MiB) so a hang or a runaway sanitizer fails fast

every step appends one JSON line to receipts.jsonl with commit, tree, verdict, seconds, toolchain, an environment digest and the SHA-256 of its log; a receipt says what ran, not that the result is true
--only takes step names and a name that is not a step fails at once so a typo cannot run nothing and pass
release binaries must be PIE with full RELRO, a non-executable stack and stack protector on ELF, and DYNAMIC_BASE, NX_COMPAT, HIGH_ENTROPY_VA and a non-empty .reloc on PE
the Linux candidate may reference at most GLIBC_2.31 and is built in the ubuntu 20.04 root filesystem with GCC 9
the Windows candidate is built with the focal mingw-w64 GCC 9.3 and a newer host toolchain changes it
a path without a rule selects every test step and so does a rule with the token ALL; Markdown and doc files select only check-dev-tools
a lint rule that scans nothing exits 2 as a hollow scan and never passes
a baseline row is path and count; a count that rises or a new path fails and update-baseline refuses while anything rose
counts bash shebangs and bashisms in shell scripts against a shrink-only baseline
counts strcpy, strcat, sprintf, vsprintf and gets in non-vendored C and C++; a lint-ok comment exempts one line
flags log and print calls whose arguments name a key, seed, mnemonic or wallet passphrase; a log-ok comment overrides one line
flags sed -i, stat -c, nproc, ss, readlink -f, date -d, grep -P and timeout in shell scripts; a port-ok comment exempts one line
flags assertions decided by elapsed real time; a real-clock comment exempts one line
a backticked repository path in tracked Markdown that resolves to no tracked file is a finding; a doc-path-ok comment exempts one line
a claim comment with predicate file-present, file-absent, symbol-present, symbol-absent, rule-passes or step-exists must be true
paragraphs of HANDOFF.md that say fixed, cured or green need a commit id, receipt path or victory-ok reason
zcutil/consensus.seal lists a git blob per sealed consensus file and the rule fails when one changed without the ritual in doc/agent/UNSEAL.md
pins the Z23 commit of the vendored C23 core and requires 55245e2bd (canonical Fr encodings) as an ancestor
pins the Z23 commit 9a191ef7b of the vendored developer-tool sources
refuses a pin that does not contain 55245e2bd
a directory summary is the first paragraph of its AGENTS.md, else README.md, else a file count; replies stay under 16 KiB
know --check fails on an undeclared term, an untracked path, a duplicate row, an unused term or a table with no rows
zcl-dev code answers map, owner, impact, cost, file, sym, refs, body and recent from the checkout
t-list lists every Boost suite, gtest suite, qa script and CI step; t-fast runs the focused set for paths
names what a host lacks to build and test zclassicd with the fix for each gap
installs and reports the git hooks with hook install and hook status
zcash-gtest loads the Sprout and Sapling parameter files from the params directory and a missing file is a failure, not a skip
differential and mainnet-block gtest cases pin consensus behaviour, so a failure there is a divergence, not a flaky test
TestingSetup builds a temporary datadir under the system temp path and a test never reads or writes a real datadir or wallet
a string argument that must be parsed as JSON needs a row in vRPCConvertParams or zclassic-cli sends it as a string
every RPC command table is registered by a Register*RPCCommands function declared here and called from RegisterAllCoreRPCCommands
aliases memcpy to memmove and defines __fdelt_chk as a weak alias of a bounds-checked __fdelt_warn, so the binary needs no newer glibc symbol version
memory_cleanse wipes key material in a way the optimizer cannot remove
CZMQNotificationInterface is a CValidationInterface that publishes block and transaction notifications over ZeroMQ when built with ENABLE_ZMQ
CBlockPolicyEstimator buckets mempool transactions by fee and priority and tracks how long each bucket takes to confirm
